# ==============================================================================

# Kenai Watershed Forum (KWF) - July 2017 Water Quality PDF Extraction Script

# Extracts analytical data from lab PDFs and formats into EPA/WQX template format.

# ==============================================================================

```{r}

library(pdftools) 
library(tidyverse) 
library(openxlsx) 
library(stringr)

install.packages(c("pdftools", "tidyverse", "openxlsx", "stringr", "lubridate")) 
library(pdftools) 
library(tidyverse) library(openxlsx) library(stringr) library(lubridate)

# 1. Monitoring Location Lookup Table

location_lookup \<- tribble( \~raw_name, \~loc_id, \~loc_name, "RM19 -Slikok Creek", "KR RM 19 SC", "Kenai River - River Mile 19 - Slikok Creek", "RM21 -Soldotna Bridge", "KR RM 21", "Kenai River - River Mile 21", "RM22 -Soldotna Creek", "KR RM 22 SOC", "Kenai River - River Mile 22 - Soldotna Creek", "RM23 -SwiftWater Park", "KR RM 23", "Kenai River - River Mile 23", "RM0 -No Name Creek", "KR RM 0 NNC", "Kenai River - River Mile 0 - "No Name" Creek", "RM1.5 -Kenai City Dock", "KR RM 1.5", "Kenai River - River Mile 1.5", "RM1.5 -Kenai City Dock Duplicate", "KR RM 1.5", "Kenai River - River Mile 1.5", "RM40 -Bing's Landing", "KR RM 40", "Kenai River - River Mile 40", "RM43 -Upstream of Dow Island", "KR RM 43", "Kenai River - River Mile 43", "RM44 -Mouth of Kelly River", "KR RM 44 KI", "Kenai River - River Mile 44 - Killey River", "RM50 -Skilak Lake Outflow", "KR RM 50", "Kenai River - River Mile 50 - Skilak Lake Outflow", "RM30 -Funny River", "KR RM 30 FR", "Kenai River - River Mile 30 - Funny River", "RM31 -Morgan's Landing", "KR RM 31", "Kenai River - River Mile 31", "RM36 -Moose River", "KR RM 36 MR", "Kenai River - River Mile 36 - Moose River", "RM36 -Moose River Duplicate", "KR RM 36 MR", "Kenai River - River Mile 36 - Moose River", "RM70 -Jims Landing", "KR RM 70", "Kenai River - River Mile 70 - Jim's Landing", "RM74 -Russian River", "KR RM 74 RR", "Kenai River - River Mile 74 - Russian River", "RM82 -Kenai Lake Bridge", "KR RM 82", "Kenai River - River Mile 82", "RM79.5 -Juneau Creek", "KR RM 79.5 JC", "Kenai River - River Mile 79.5 - Juneau Creek" )

# List of PDF report files in working directory

pdf_files \<- list.files(pattern = "\^A1707.\*\\.pdf\$")

# Initialize result storage

extracted_rows \<- list()

# 2. Main Extraction Loop

for (pdf_file in pdf_files) { cat("Processing report:", pdf_file, "\n") text_pages \<- pdf_text(pdf_file)

for (page_num in seq_along(text_pages)) { page_txt \<- text_pages\[\[page_num\]\] lines \<- str_split(page_txt, "\n")\[\[1\]\] %\>% str_trim()

```         
# Check if page is a client sample page
if (any(str_detect(lines, "Client Sample Report")) && any(str_detect(lines, "Client Sample Name:"))) {
  
  # Parse Sample Metadata
  sample_name <- str_match(page_txt, "Client Sample Name:\\s*\n?\\s*(.*?)\\s*Matrix:")[, 2]
  if (is.na(sample_name)) {
    sample_name <- lines[which(str_detect(lines, "Client Sample Name:")) + 1]
  }
  sample_name <- str_trim(sample_name)
  
  coll_datetime <- str_match(page_txt, "Collection Date:\\s*(\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}\\s+\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\s*[AP]M)")[, 2]
  lab_sample_id <- str_match(page_txt, "Lab Sample Number:\\s*([A-Z0-9-]+)")[, 2]
  
  # Determine Activity Type & Duplicate Tag
  is_dup <- str_detect(sample_name, "Duplicate")
  is_blank <- str_detect(sample_name, "Trip Blank")
  
  activity_type <- if (is_blank) {
    "Quality Control Sample-Field Blank"
  } else if (is_dup) {
    "Quality Control Field Replicate Msr/Obs"
  } else {
    "Field Msr/Obs"
  }
  
  dup_code <- if (is_dup) "DUP" else NA_character_
  
  # Lookup Location ID
  loc_match <- location_lookup %>% filter(raw_name == sample_name)
  loc_id <- if (nrow(loc_match) > 0) loc_match$loc_id[[1]] else ifelse(is_blank, paste0("TB-", str_sub(pdf_file, 1, 8)), sample_name)
  
  # Parse Analytical Target Lines
  for (line in lines) {
    # Match Parameter lines (Metals, Nutrients, VOCs)
    if (str_detect(line, "^(Arsenic|Cadmium|Chromium|Copper|Lead|Zinc|Calcium|Iron|Magnesium|Phosphorous, Total|Nitrate-Nitrite as Nitrogen|Benzene|Ethylbenzene|Toluene|Xylenes, Total)")) {
      
      parts <- str_split(line, "\\s+")[[1]]
      char_name <- case_when(
        str_detect(line, "Phosphorous") ~ "Phosphorous, Total",
        str_detect(line, "Nitrate-Nitrite") ~ "Nitrate-Nitrite as Nitrogen",
        str_detect(line, "Xylenes") ~ "Xylenes, Total",
        TRUE ~ parts[1]
      )
      
      # Extract values, units, qualifiers
      is_nd <- str_detect(line, "ND")
      has_j <- str_detect(line, "J")
      
      # Extract numerical result
      res_val <- if (is_nd) "ND" else str_extract(line, "(\\d+\\.\\d+|\\d+,?\\d*)")
      res_qual <- if (is_nd) "U" else if (has_j) "J" else NA_character_
      
      unit <- case_when(
        str_detect(line, "ug/L") ~ "ug/L",
        str_detect(line, "mg/L") ~ "mg/L",
        TRUE ~ "ug/L"
      )
      
      method_id <- case_when(
        char_name %in% c("Calcium", "Iron", "Magnesium") ~ "EPA 200.7",
        char_name %in% c("Arsenic", "Cadmium", "Chromium", "Copper", "Lead", "Zinc") ~ "EPA 200.8",
        char_name == "Phosphorous, Total" ~ "SM4500-PE",
        char_name == "Nitrate-Nitrite as Nitrogen" ~ "SM4500-NO3E",
        char_name %in% c("Benzene", "Ethylbenzene", "Toluene", "Xylenes, Total") ~ "EPA 624",
        TRUE ~ "EPA Method"
      )
      
      lab_name <- case_when(
        method_id %in% c("SM4500-PE", "SM4500-NO3E") ~ "ARS Aleut Analytical, LLC",
        method_id == "EPA 624" ~ "SGS Environmental Services Inc.",
        TRUE ~ "TestAmerica - Denver"
      )
      
      # Append formatted record
      extracted_rows[[length(extracted_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Project ID` = NA_character_,
        `Client Sample Name` = sample_name,
        `Monitoring Location ID` = loc_id,
        `Activity Media Name` = "Water",
        `Activity Media Subdivision Name` = "Surface Water",
        `Sample Condition` = NA_character_,
        `Lab Sample Number` = lab_sample_id,
        `Activity ID` = paste0(loc_id, "-", str_sub(coll_datetime, 1, 10), "-", char_name, if_else(is.na(dup_code), "", "-DUP")),
        `Activity Start Date` = as.character(as.Date(str_sub(coll_datetime, 1, 10), "%m/%d/%Y")),
        `Activity Start Time` = str_sub(coll_datetime, 12),
        `Activity Start Time Zone` = "AKST",
        `Activity Type` = activity_type,
        `Characteristic Name` = char_name,
        `Result Analytical Method ID` = method_id,
        `Result Value` = res_val,
        `Result Unit` = unit,
        `Result Qualifier` = res_qual,
        `Laboratory Name` = lab_name
      )
    }
  }
}
```

} }

# 3. Combine into final dataframe

final_df \<- bind_rows(extracted_rows)

# 4. Save Outputs

write_csv(final_df, "Kenai_River_July_2017_Extracted_R.csv") write.xlsx(final_df, "Kenai_River_July_2017_Extracted_R.xlsx")

cat("Success! Extracted", nrow(final_df), "parameter records.\n")
